title: Hentai ero seiheki: Chijiruzeme
original_title: 変態エロ性癖 恥汁責め
overview: At the café where he worked part-time, Shoichi got into a confrontation with a customer couple, Kikuchi and Azusa; Kikuchi doused him with juice and hurled insults at him. Yet, for some reason, Shoichi was enraptured by the experience. Aimi, a fellow part-timer, comforted him as he felt dejected after being scolded by the manager. The two grew close very quickly...
